# Test Fixtures

Frozen reference fixtures. **These files are committed on purpose** and must not be regenerated
casually: every fidelity number in the README, in `PERFORMANCE.md` and in the test suite is a
comparison against exactly these bytes.

They are ~31 MB on disk and ~1.2 MB deflated (`image.bin`, `image_caption.bin` and `image_pre.bin` are
mostly padding and near-empty pixel regions), so the cost of keeping them in git is small.

Each file is produced by a generator in `tools/` that runs the **HF reference implementation**
(PyTorch / transformers, and ONNX for `text_checks.bin`) on the same input. Regenerating needs the
1.4 GB checkpoint, PyTorch and transformers; three of the generators additionally need
`bench/fixtures/*.npz` and `scripts/onnx_common.py` from the model workspace, which is why they are
development-time tools and not part of the build.

## Text

**`text_query.bin`** (3.1 KB) and **`text_doc.bin`** (3.8 KB) - the primary text fixtures: one 15-token
query and one 196-token document, each with the reference 768-d embedding.

```
int32 n_ids, int32 dim, int32 ids[n_ids], float ref[dim]
```

Generated by `tools/dump_fixtures.py` from `bench/fixtures/{inputs,reference}.npz`. Read by `test_text`
(both cases), and by `test_gpu_text` / `test_hip_text` (each case separately).

**`text_checks.bin`** (157 KB) - the golden FP32 corpus: 42 cases including kernel-shape boundaries
and eight retrieval pairs whose ranking must be preserved.

```
uint32 header[4] (magic 0x54583245 "E2XT"), then per case:
char name[64], int32 n, int32 ids[n], float ref[768]
```

Generated by `tools/dump_text_checks.py` (ONNX). Read by `test_text_reference`, and by
`test_gpu_text_reference` with the `gpu` argument. This is the corpus that exposed the SIMD
exponential bug, so it is the highest-value fixture here.

**`text_masked.bin`** (8.2 KB) - one sequence with a validity mask, for the batch API: the batch of 3
must reproduce the single-sequence embedding of the same masked input.

```
int32 n, int32 dim, int32 ids[n], uint8 mask[n], float ref[768]
```

Generated by `tools/dump_text_checks.py`. Read by `test_text_batch`.

## Vision

**`image.bin`** (7.4 MB) - image-only input: the padded `(2520, 768)` `pixel_values` tensor, its
position ids and the reference 768-d embedding.

```
int32 n_patches, patch_dim, n_pos, dim, float pixels[n_patches*patch_dim],
int32 positions[n_patches*2], float ref[dim]
```

Generated by `tools/dump_image_fixture.py`. Read by `test_image`, `test_gpu_image`, `test_hip_image`,
and by `test_audio` for its text+image+audio case.

**`image_caption.bin`** (7.4 MB) - the same for the `<|image|>` caption layout: token ids around the
soft-token block, then the patches, then the reference embedding.

```
int32 n_ids, n_patches, patch_dim, dim, int32 ids[n_ids], float pixels[...],
int32 positions[...], float ref[dim]
```

Generated by `tools/dump_image_fixture.py`. Read by `test_image`, `test_gpu_image`, `test_hip_image`.

**`image_pre.bin`** (14.4 MB) - the preprocessing ground truth: for each test image, the source PNG,
the processor's resized RGB output, and the resulting patch tensor and position ids.

```
uint32 n, then per image: int32 w, h, uint32 pnglen, uint8 png[pnglen],
int32 tw, th, uint32 nres, uint8 resized[nres], int32 n_patches, uint32 full,
[float pixels[2520*768], int32 pos[2520*2]]   (only when full)
```

Generated by `tools/dump_image_fixture_pre.py`. Read by `test_preprocess` - it needs no checkpoint.

**`png.bin`** (89 KB) - the PNG filter matrix: every colour type and bit depth the reader supports,
with each of the five scanline filters forced onto row 0 and cycled through the remaining rows. Run
through **both** decoders when libpng is in the build, which doubles as their cross-check.

Generated by `tools/dump_png_fixture.py` from hand-built PNGs plus Pillow's decode. Read by
`test_preprocess`. This is the test that catches a missing zeroed "previous row": filter bytes live
inside the compressed stream, so neither a mutation fuzzer nor any ordinary file reaches all of them.

**`codec.bin`** (97 KB) - JPEG/WebP/PNG in all eight EXIF orientations, plus truncated and mutated
files that must be refused cleanly.

Generated by `tools/dump_codec_fixture.py`. Read by `test_preprocess`; formats the build cannot decode
are reported as skipped rather than failed.

## Audio

**`audio.bin`** (129 KB) - 0.75 s of synthetic 16 kHz PCM (three swept tones under an envelope, so it
is deterministic), the reference mel, the reference soft tokens and the reference embeddings of
text+audio and text+image+audio. 0.75 s is deliberately not a whole number of 4-frame groups, which is
what exercises the tail mask and the `ceil()` in the soft-token count (75 mel frames -> 19 soft
tokens).

```
int32 n_samples, n_mel_frames, n_soft, dim, n_ids, soft_dim, n_img_soft, text_len
char  text[text_len]                the prompt, with one `<|audio|>` marker
float pcm[n_samples]                16 kHz mono
int32 ids[n_ids]                    the text+audio layout, as the processor builds it
float mel[n_mel_frames*128]         reference mel features
uint8 mask[n_mel_frames]            reference frame mask
float soft[n_soft*soft_dim]         reference audio soft tokens
float ref_ta[dim]                   reference 768d of text+audio
float ref_tia[dim]                  reference 768d of text+image+audio
```

Generated by `tools/dump_audio_fixture.py`. Read by `test_audio`, `test_gpu_audio`.

## Tokenizer

**`tokenizer.bin`** (485 KB) - text -> ids corpus from the model's own `tokenizer.json`: BPE with byte
fallback, the `<bos>`/`<eos>` template, and the awkward cases (empty string, unicode, code,
whitespace).

```
uint32 n, then per case: uint32 nbytes, uint8 bytes[nbytes], uint32 nids, int32 ids[nids]
```

**`tokenizer_mm.bin`** (1.2 KB) - the same for `<|image|>` placeholder expansion: the text, the soft
token counts, and the resulting ids.

```
uint32 n, then per case: uint32 nbytes, uint8 bytes[nbytes], uint32 nimg, int32 soft[nimg],
uint32 nids, int32 ids[nids]
```

Both generated by `tools/dump_tokenizer_fixture.py` from the HF tokenizer, read by `test_preprocess`.
Neither needs the checkpoint - only `tokenizer.json`.

## Verification

```bash
./build/e2_test_pre models/embeddinggemma-2 tests/fixtures   # tokenizer + preprocessing, ~1 s
./build/e2_test     models/embeddinggemma-2 tests/fixtures   # text
./build/e2_test_image models/embeddinggemma-2 tests/fixtures
./build/e2_test_audio models/embeddinggemma-2 tests/fixtures
```

Reference cosines for the committed files are in [../PERFORMANCE.md](../../PERFORMANCE.md#fidelity).
int8 is 0.9994-0.9998 and bf16 is 0.9997-0.9999; a change that moves a number by more than ~0.0001 is
a real regression, not float noise.
